concept.reason: Actual two fossil images, named measured hindlimbs and official morphological description suffice.

scope: Whole living rail-like bird with long walking legs, a short pointed slightly hooked bill and broad elongated feathered tail.

scientific_limits.en: SMF ME3550 is an articulated flattened specimen, not a volumetric body scan. Measured tibiotarsus and tarsometatarsus constrain legs; 30cm is a museum species-level size estimate, not an exact individual dimension. Feather preservation is usually poor; tail length supported, broad closed fan and plumage volume are original reconstruction. No proven color or extravagant crest. The historical sunbittern affinity is not adopted as current taxonomy.
scientific_limits.zh: SMF ME3550为压扁关联骨架，非全体体积扫描。胫跗骨及跗跖骨实测约束腿长，30厘米为官方种级估计非该个体实测。羽保存一般较差，长尾有证据，宽闭合扇尾及羽量为原创复原。颜色与夸张头冠无实证；不采用旧太阳鸟亲缘假说为现行分类。

classification: Aves, Gruiformes, Messelornithidae; relative of rails/finfoots, not modern sunbittern

scale.measurement_source: Morlo2004 actual specimen, inferred male among largest individuals.
scale.model_status: Whole dimensions and fleshed proportions original estimates; leg bone measurements retained separately.

diagnostic_targets: Small compact rail-like trunk elevated on long slim but weight-bearing walking legs, not tiny crouched duck legs.
Short narrow tapering bill with modest downhook at very tip, not long heron spear or deep parrot/terrorbird hook.
Moderate curved neck and small rounded head; no cassowary helmet or elaborate invented crest.
Conspicuous elongated broad overlapping feather tail, not tiny upright modern rail stub or bony dinosaur tail.
Two modest folded feather wings and neutral plumage, clearly feathered body rather than bare skeleton.
Three forward toes and rear hallux with modest claws; terrestrial nonwebbed feet, balanced stance. Toe soft-tissue reconstruction from bird comparisons.
acceptance: Complete original long-legged rail silhouette, short pointed bill and broad long tail visible together.
Side: tarsometatarsus near88% of tibiotarsus bony length, body not grounded and tail not a small nub.
Top/perspective: overlapping broad feather tail and narrow bill distinct; no invented crest or webbing.
Measurements distinguish specific bone lengths from museum size estimate and original living dimensions.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds, independent review.
